sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Assesses opportunities to consolidate or eliminate redundant applications. Identifies cost-saving and efficiency improvement areas. Supports strategic decision-making for application portfolio management. Aligns IT capabilities with business needs. Facilitates transition to a streamlined application landscape.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Reduces costs by eliminating redundant applications. Improves efficiency and system performance. Aligns IT with business priorities. Supports strategic transformation. Enhances agility and responsiveness.
